title: CRIC API and SDK Specification
summary: Defines CRIC's programmatic interface layer: Python SDK, REST API, CLI, error and pagination contracts, OpenAPI generation, and a future MCP adapter.
notes: Dominant signals are SPEC: endpoint listings (/api/v1/...), SDK namespaces, request filters, machine-readable error schema, pagination rules, OpenAPI generation. Filename carries the 'Specification' convention. Contains a 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section (a PRD signal), but it enumerates implementation contracts rather than user stories or business requirements; ambiguity resolved to SPEC per SPEC > PRD precedence. No markdown links or explicit doc paths present, so cross_refs is empty despite prose mentions of PRD documentation and Agent Commons.
